description: London Airports Open Data 2026 — journey times and Gulf air routes is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tripyana Ltd (Tripyana Ltd, London). Five CSV files: (1) predicted drive times between each of the five London airports and Park Lane W1, both directions, every hour of a weekday and a Saturday in September 2026 (384 rows); (2) Park Lane and Heathrow to Windsor Castle, hourly (192 rows); (3) Park Lane to 12 day-trip destinations, hourly, out and back ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
